description: Add delete button in customer list rows, verify receipt matches slip content, and add PDF upload feature for signed agreement documents with visual highlighting.
steps: Step 1: Verify receipt.html matches the user's provided consultation fee slip content (same structure, Hindi/English text, fee of 500, 5 purpose points, signature blocks).
Step 2: Add a Delete button in both dashboard and customers table rows (rowHtml function) so users can delete directly from the list without opening detail view.

Step 3: Add PDF upload feature - manual multipart form parser in server.js (no multer needed due to npm registry restrictions), upload endpoint POST /api/customers/:id/upload-agreement, delete endpoint DELETE /api/customers/:id/agreement, and /uploads static file serving.
Step 4: Add upload UI in customer detail view - drag-and-drop area, file picker, view/remove buttons for existing uploads.
Step 5: Add green PDF badge indicator next to customer name in list rows when a signed agreement PDF has been uploaded.
Step 6: Auto-delete associated PDF files when a customer is deleted.
acceptance_criteria: receipt.html content matches the user's slip exactly (same owner, title, fee details, 5 purpose points, signature blocks)
Delete button appears in each row of both the dashboard table and customers table
Delete from list shows confirmation prompt and removes the customer
PDF upload UI appears in customer detail view with drag-and-drop support
Only PDF files are accepted (validated both client and server side)
Uploaded PDFs are stored in /uploads directory with naming convention agreement-{customerId}.pdf
Customer object in state.json gets agreementPdf field when PDF is uploaded
Green PDF badge shows next to customer name in list rows when agreement is uploaded
Uploaded PDF can be viewed in new tab and removed via UI
Deleting a customer also deletes their associated PDF file
No external dependencies added (manual multipart parser used)
verification: JavaScript in index.html is syntactically valid
All receipt content items verified programmatically
All feature checks pass (deleteCustomerFromList, badge-pdf, setupUploadUI, etc.)
findings: npm registry is blocked (403 Forbidden) so multer could not be installed. Implemented a manual multipart/form-data parser in server.js that handles single PDF file uploads without any external dependency. The parser reads the raw request body, parses multipart boundaries, and extracts the file data.
